summary: Frontend-only testing (Playwright, Chromium 1920x1080) of the 3 requested flows on the preview URL. FLUX 1 (admin creates user manually) PASS: login as admin@cartoonix.ro OK, /admin -> tab 'Membri' OK, dialog 'Creează utilizator' opens, fields create-name/create-email/create-password + create-plus checkbox work, save-new-user returns success toast 'Cont creat pentru qa_374957@cartoonix.ro', dialog closes, list refreshes and new user appears via members-search with the PLUS badge and 'Activ' status. FLUX 1b (duplicate) PASS: same email -> HTTP 400 and error toast 'Acest email este deja folosit', no duplicate row created (list still shows 1 result for that email, total stayed 5). FLUX 2 (OTP error message) PASS: /register submit -> POST /api/auth/register/start returns 400 and the page shows in data-testid='register-error' the SPECIFIC Romanian message 'Nu am putut trimite emailul de verificare. Încearcă din nou.'; generic 'A apărut o eroare' was NOT shown. No JS errors other than benign React warnings.

create-password input uses type='text' (password shown in clear text) - intentional for admin convenience but worth confirming

critical_code_review_comments: AdminMembers.load() swallows API errors with .catch(() => {}) - a failing /admin/users request silently shows an empty table; surface an error state

Register.jsx error path is correct now (formatApiErrorDetail on detail); note that using HTTP 400 for a mail-provider failure is a semantic compromise (5xx would be correct) - documented workaround for the Cloudflare proxy masking 5xx bodies

rca_of_the_issue: Previously the register/start Brevo failure returned 5xx whose JSON body was replaced by the Cloudflare proxy, so the frontend fell back to the generic message. Backend now returns 400 with the detail string, which reaches formatApiErrorDetail and renders in data-testid='register-error'. Verified in browser.
